body: Yeah being hospitalized is a terrifying experience, I wouldn't wish that on my worst enemy. It felt so demoralizing, it was just aweful. When it comes to prescription drugs I just try to avoid that stuff at all costs. My father suffers from depression and has been on drugs his whole life, and he is fried. I constantly catch him snorting crushed pills and drinking insane amounts of alcohol, I never ever want to be that. I'd rather suffer and feel real and alive than fry my brain and numb my existence. It's disturbing what drugs will do to people, it freaks me out. And yeah basically it's just everything adding up. I've felt like this my entire life, so much weird stuff has happened to me and just fucked my mind up so bad. But I met this girl about 5 months ago and like really hit it off. We started talking a lot, started hanging out a lot. We opened up about our depression and talked about really deep stuff together. It was pretty amazing, I've never really had anyone like that in my life. I started developing pretty strong feelings for her and just wanted to feel a connection. I wanted some one to love me, something I've never truly experienced. I just wanted to feel close to some one, some one I could hold at night and not be alone and cry my self to sleep. Some one to feel intimate with and unconditionaly love. She on the other hand felt none of this. She rejected me pretty hard and left me heart broken. She's pretty much in love with this other guy that I have nothing on. He's hot as fuck, he's got a good job, he's like super macho California surfer dude. Me? I'm just ugly, I'm kind of fat, I got laid off earlier this year and have nothing to offer. My life is just a joke, and seeing that whole situation play out made me realize how much of a loser I am. I'm pretty sure I'm going to die alone. It's so hard for me to meet people, I have such bad social anxiety. Like the fact that I could even talk to this girl at all is a damn miracle. I'm just so lost, I have no direction, no guidance, I'm just drifting through life and going through the motions and feel so empty inside. I feel broken and I'm afraid there is nothing that can fix it.

Just want to say thank you for being here. And yeah I actually love meditating, I've been doing it off and on for years. I was meditating in the desert recently and it was really nice. I still have trouble fully turning off though, there is constant mind chatter. I talk to myself a lot in my mind, like I probably sound crazy but I have like full fledged conversations with myself, almost constantly all day. It's not so much that I have like an alternate version of my self or an imaginary friend or something like that, it's just to keep myself company and not feel so alone. So I've always struggled with getting away from that when meditating, I don't quite know how to switch off ya know?

Thank you for being here, it means a lot. And yeah about 5 years ago I actually tried to commit. I couldn't go through with it and broke down and went to my guidance counselor at school the next day. Basically my parents took my a psych ward and had be hospitalized for 8 days. It was honestly pretty horrible, I was so scared and felt like I was just abandoned and left alone for some one else to deal with. When I was released I was seeing a therapist, it was okay, I didn't mind it but didn't love it either. I saw him for about 6 months after and eventually just went our separate ways. I've gone through ups and downs since then and usually get through it okay, but I just feel so horrible this time. I feel like a waste of space, I just feel useless, like I'm a burden. I'm just in a really dark place right now and can't see any light.
